correctness.rationale: At each known axial maximizer the active circular-edge pair has strict slack on inactive balls and positive support multipliers. This yields an exact local support formula. value.rationale: The unit Reuleaux tetrahedron is a canonical nonconstant-width ball intersection; the new exact two-term exceedance law is a natural caliper-direction statistic about its exceptionally wide opposite edges.
